sourceLabel: Supplied New Anmol Group of Institutions photographs and campus film
sourceNotes: The supplied photographs identify campus spaces, laboratories, nursing cohorts and faculty; no event dates are printed in the supplied media.
The supplied campus film shows regional context, campus interiors, practical nursing spaces, a seminar setting and the college exterior.
